metadata.title: Bhoomi Insight regional indicators
notes: Forest cover data is from ISFR 2023 Table 9.1.
Agriculture land and cultivated land are provisional 2024-25 values from DES Agriculture Table IX.
Population is Census 2011 baseline. Current administrative boundary changes mean some population splits require caution.
Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh share the combined geographical-area value in ISFR Table 9.1; do not interpret it as an individual area.
Andhra Pradesh and Telangana 2011 population figures are represented on post-2014 state boundaries using Census 2011 population counts; combined former Andhra Pradesh is not copied into both states.
Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu population is the sum of the two 2011 Census predecessor UT counts.
